title: Load Dashboard with Real Data
description: Verify that the dashboard loads successfully within 2 seconds and displays real enrollment statistics and progress data fetched via getStudentDashboardStats server action using the userId prop.

steps.description: Login as a valid student and navigate to /student-dashboard.
Ensure userId prop is passed from StudentDashboardClient to Dashboard component.
Dashboard executes getStudentDashboardStats server action to fetch enrollment data.
Dashboard renders statistics counters with enrolled, active, and completed course counts matching server response.
Dashboard loads completely within 2 seconds.

title: Validate My Courses Grid Rendering
description: Check that the My Courses Grid displays all enrolled courses with correct thumbnails, course titles, instructor names, progress bars, and lesson completion counts.

steps.description: Login as a student with multiple enrolled courses.
Navigate to the student dashboard.
Each course card shows a valid thumbnail image.
Each course card displays correct course titles and instructor names retrieved from backend.
Progress bars reflect accurate course progress percentages.
Lesson completion counts on each card match backend data.
Click a course card.
User navigates to the correct course detail page.

title: Continue Learning Section Displays Correct Next Lesson
description: Verify the Continue Learning section shows the next recommended lesson with course and lesson titles, thumbnail, and link to continue, based on recent activity of the student.

steps.description: Login as a student with recent learning progress.
Navigate to the student dashboard.
Continue Learning section shows the correct next lesson title and corresponding course title.
Thumbnail for the lesson is displayed correctly.
Click the continue button/link.
User is routed correctly to the lesson page.

title: Overall Progress Circular Indicator Accuracy
description: Check that the circular indicator displays the average completion percentage across all active courses correctly.

steps.description: Login as a student with multiple active courses.
Navigate to the student dashboard.
Calculate average completion percentage from backend data.
Verify that the circular progress indicator matches the calculated average.

title: Empty State Handling for No Enrollments
description: Verify dashboard displays appropriate messaging and UI when the student has no enrolled courses.

steps.description: Login as a student with zero enrolled courses.
Navigate to the student dashboard.
Dashboard statistics counters show zero values appropriately.
My Courses Grid does not display any courses.
Continue Learning section is hidden or displays a message indicating no lessons available.
Empty state message encourages enrollment, and is free from visual bugs.

title: Data Integration Using userId Prop and Server Action
description: Ensure that the userId prop correctly flows from StudentDashboardClient to Dashboard and triggers getStudentDashboardStats server action to fetch data.

steps.description: Login as any student and navigate to student dashboard.
Observe the prop passed from StudentDashboardClient to Dashboard.
Dashboard component receives correct userId.
Dashboard calls getStudentDashboardStats server action with userId.
Server action returns correct data matching the logged-in student.

title: TypeScript Migration Cleanup Verification
description: Verify that no duplicate JavaScript files (Dashboard.js, index.js, page.js) remain after migration and all .tsx files load error-free without affecting dashboard functionality.

steps.description: Review project directory to confirm removal of Dashboard.js, index.js, page.js.
Only .tsx files remain as source of truth for dashboard components.
Build and run the project.
No TypeScript errors are reported related to dashboard components.
Navigate to the student dashboard in the application.
Dashboard loads and functions correctly with no regressions.

title: Navigation Verification from Dashboard Cards and Buttons
description: Test navigation flows from course cards in My Courses Grid and continue buttons in Continue Learning section route users to appropriate course or lesson pages.

steps.description: Login as a student with enrolled courses and active lessons.
Navigate to student dashboard.
Click a course card in My Courses Grid.
Verify navigation to correct course detail page.
Click continue button in Continue Learning section.
Verify navigation to the accurate lesson page.

title: UI Responsiveness and Visual Integrity
description: Validate that dashboard UI components, including statistics counters, My Courses Grid, Continue Learning section, and progress indicators, render correctly on different devices and screen sizes without layout breaks.

steps.description: Login as a student with sample data.
Open student dashboard on desktop screen size.
Verify UI components are properly aligned and visually consistent.
Resize browser viewport to tablet and mobile screen sizes.
Dashboard components adapt and maintain usability without overlapping or truncation.
